options: Microsoft Teams client (only if your tenant allows its localhost sign-in)

fields.title: Sign-in app id
fields.body: The public client m365 signs in with. Chat.ReadWrite and ChatMessage.Send must be consented for it in your tenant; if user consent is restricted, a tenant administrator approves them once. Any other app id (a GUID) can be set as appId in config.yaml. Sign in again after changing it.
